race.comment: Tough finish. HERE TO SHOCK (4) was okay fresh in the Chautauqua Stakes when fading late. He should come on nicely from that and gets a good draw to stalk a hot speed. BUCCLEUCH (13) is the ultra-progressive one off two big wins this time in. He's horribly in at the set weights on official ratings but is clearly better than what he's shown so far and with some luck from the gate he'll measure up. HARRY'S YACHT (9) was solid fresh in The Heath and is suited up to his pet trip now. Kept ticking over with a recent trial win at Flemington. Likely to be about the money. ATHANATOS (2) boasts fine black-type credentials. Lines up for the first time since proving too classy in the Lord Mayor's Cup over 1800m at Eagle Farm on May 30. Each-way.
